note: Nemaha NRD recreation area (opened 2018) on a 62-acre no-wake lake, 5 mi NW of Peru (2 mi E of US 75 on 736 Rd). 28 paved 50-amp pads in a hilltop loop ~250-400 m from the lake across open grass, plus 4 primitive RV pads; no water hookups or dump station. Drinking-water hydrants, primitive restrooms, swim beach, boat ramp. RVs only on campsites, which must be attended. --Claude
